examples.before: troupe.yml: `system: |   # main prompt` / `You are a coder.` / a blank line holding 4 spaces / `Be terse.` / `Use tests.` / `# end of prompts`
examples.input:
`config set prompts.system "You are a coder.

Be terse.
Use more tests.
"` (only the last line changes, from `Use tests.`)

results.1: Only `Use tests.` becomes `Use more tests.`. The 4-space blank line, the `# main prompt` comment and `# end of prompts` are unchanged.
results.2: All five arms: `Use tests.` becomes `Use more tests.`, and the 4-space blank line is also emptied to a bare blank line. Both comments are kept.

examples.input:
`config set prompts.system "You are a senior coder.

Be terse.
Use more tests.
Explain briefly.
"`

results.1: The first line is rewritten and `Explain briefly.` is added inside the block. The 4-space blank line is still there, and comments and `model: opus` are unchanged.
results.2: All five arms: the same edits, and the blank line stays empty. Comments and `model: opus` are unchanged.

examples.before: agents.yml: `prompt: |` / `  Review diffs.` / `  Check tests.` / `level: 2`, all with CRLF
examples.input:
`config set reviewer.prompt "Review diffs carefully.
Check tests.
Be kind.
"` (the value lives in agents.yml, which uses CRLF line endings)

results.1: Line 1 is edited and `Be kind.` is added. Every line keeps its CRLF ending, and `level: 2` is unchanged.
results.2: All five arms: identical to route 1, with CRLF kept on every line.

results.1:
Prints `You are a senior coder.

Be terse.
Use more tests.
Explain briefly.
` and `Review diffs carefully.
Check tests.
Be kind.
`.
results.2: All five arms: the same output as route 1.

context.in_practice: Both routes store and return the same values, and both keep comments, neighbouring keys and CRLF line endings. The only difference seen: route 1 left an untouched whitespace-only line inside the block exactly as it was, while route 2 stripped it to an empty line. The value read back is the same either way, but a diff of the file shows a change you did not make.
context.stakes: When you edit a multi-line prompt with `config set`, the question is whether lines you did not change stay byte-for-byte as they were. Comments, line endings and stray whitespace in a hand-written file could otherwise be rewritten without warning.
context.tradeoff: Route 1 keeps unchanged lines byte-for-byte but needs extra line-matching logic. Route 2 is simpler but can quietly normalise whitespace on lines you never edited.

plan_why: Edits existing literal blocks (one with extra 6-space indentation, a whitespace-only blank line, a trailing blank line and a header comment; one in a CRLF include). A line diff leaves the unchanged lines and the surrounding layout byte-identical; a whole-block rewrite would re-indent or normalise them.
routes: Line diff with difflib so unchanged lines keep their bytes
